Verification plugin

ui-test

Lets one agent send another agent to operate the real interface and bring back inspectable proof.

ROLE IN THE FACTORY

Observed product proof

The builder, runner, and verifier stay separate. A Claude session can author the test, Ringer can dispatch a Codex computer-use worker, and a fresh verifier can judge the returned screenshots.

What it provides

A bounded capability with a clear handoff.

  • Typed test instructions with explicit preconditions and assertion IDs
  • Codex computer-use runs against native macOS, FileMaker, and Electron windows
  • Screenshots and on-screen values tagged by accessibility or pixel evidence
  • Executed receipt checks for required images, IDs, and literal observations
  • Fresh-context verdicts: PASS-OBSERVED, FAIL, or BLOCKED

The handoff

01Claudeauthors test
02Ringerdispatches
03Codexdrives UI
04Checksvalidate receipt
05Verifierreads proof

Why it matters

Claude can ask Codex to test the app

The active Claude session keeps product context. Codex receives a narrow computer-use assignment, operates the actual window, and captures the required checkpoints. The result comes back through Ringer with files and a machine-checked receipt, then a separate verifier reads the captures before a product verdict is accepted.
